title.zh: 高频估计推广与 1.32301 合成

description.zh: 把 #2643 提升为最终一致的小量，并试把移动窗口推广到 n²+a 和 α≤1.325。当前指数路线先补低频的内外两段，再把零频、低频、高频和重复赋值预算在同一尺度合成。
description.en: Extract eventual smallness from #2643 and explore moving windows for n²+a and α≤1.325. For the current exponent, prove the two low-mode bounds and combine zero, low, high and excess masses on the same scales.
